display.purpose: Hero headlines only. One per screen.

headline.purpose: Section headings. Structural weight without demanding attention.

title.purpose: Feature card headings, diary entry dates, sub-section introductions.

body-lg.purpose: Lead paragraphs and hero subheadlines. Max 65ch.

label.purpose: All UI chrome: nav links, button text, tags, status indicators. Always uppercase.

shadows.name: nav-ambient
shadows.purpose: The floating navigation pill only. Signals elevation above the canvas.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA button only. A warmth-signal, not a depth-shadow. One per screen maximum.

shadows.name: hero-stack
shadows.purpose: Stacked diary cards in the hero. Figurative — reinforces the paper-stack metaphor. Not for general UI cards.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all entrances and state transitions. Expo-out — fast onset, graceful settle.

motion.name: scroll-cascade
motion.value: animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry X% entry Y%
motion.purpose: Scroll-driven entrance pattern. Each child staggers 8% behind the previous. Used in .gi-v1 and all future bento card entrances.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Hover and focus state transitions. Fast enough to feel immediate.

motion.name: duration-entrance
motion.purpose: Entrance animations and color transitions on nav links.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact nav-scale CTA. Hearthlight fill on near-black — the brand signal in minimal footprint.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #ffb77d; color: #4d2600; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb77d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: CTA Button
components.description: Full-saturation hero CTA. The one moment of color conviction per page — Hearthlight Deep at maximum emphasis.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #d97707; color: #432100; padding: 20px 40px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(217,119,6,0.3); transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-cta:hover { transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(217,119,6,0.4); } .ds-btn-cta:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb77d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action alongside CTA. Honest border, no color.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #e5e2e1; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #554336; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #353535; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb77d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Pill
components.description: Glassmorphic floating pill. The one element in the UI that uses backdrop-blur.

components.name: Integration Tile

components.css: .ds-integration-tile { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; background: #20201f; border: 1px solid rgba(85,67,54,0.3); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #dbc2b0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-integration-tile:hover { color: #f59e0b; border-color: rgba(255,183,125,0.5); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Footer system state indicator. Understated — the pulse dot is the signal.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(53,53,53,0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(85,67,54,0.1); } .ds-status-badge__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #a0d663; animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } } .ds-status-badge__label { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #dbc2b0; }

narrative.overview:
WeaveDiary's visual language is built on stillness as a design stance. The interface does not announce itself. It is a calm surface that holds the weight of a day's accumulated activity without dramatizing it — a tool that respects the user's attention by never competing for it. Every element is placed with intention; nothing moves without purpose; nothing decorates without function.

The palette is a near-black field with warm, tinted neutrals that carry the suggestion of aged paper and candlelight. The single accent — Hearthlight, a warm amber-orange — appears sparingly, marking what matters: a prompt, a CTA, an icon with meaning. Its rarity is its authority. The serif headline font (Newsreader) brings editorial weight and a faint analog quality to daily entries; the sans body (Manrope) carries information cleanly without personality-clash.

WeaveDiary explicitly rejects the aesthetic conventions of the tools its users have outgrown: no bullet-point journal chrome, no Notion-style text-editor bleakness, no AI-first dashboard theatrics, no cold productivity SaaS minimalism. This is not a dashboard. It is a record.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas with warm tonal surface steps — depth through tone, not drop shadows
One accent color used with strict restraint; its presence is a signal, not decoration
Serif display type for headlines and diary copy; sans-serif for all UI chrome
Grain texture on key surfaces as a material reference to analog paper
Components that breathe: generous internal padding, deliberate radius choices
Motion that confirms, not entertains: scroll-driven entrances, no idle animation

rules.name: The Hearthlight Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on ≤10% of any screen. One icon, one CTA, one headline emphasis, one status dot — then stop. If you reach for Hearthlight a fourth time, the third use is wrong.

rules.name: The Warm Tint Rule
rules.body: No pure blacks or pure whites. Every neutral carries a warm hue shift — #131313 not #000000; #e5e2e1 not #ffffff. The palette reads warm even in deep dark.

rules.name: The Italic Signal Rule
rules.body: Newsreader italic is reserved for diary entry prose, pull quotes, and the brand name. It is not a UI emphasis tool. To emphasize a heading, use weight or scale — not italic.

rules.name: The Label Lock Rule
rules.body: Label text is always uppercase at 0.05em tracking. Never sentence-case a label. Never reduce the tracking. Never use Newsreader at label size.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Feature cards, bento tiles, and content containers are flat at rest. Tonal surface difference carries the depth signal. A shadow on a resting card means the card is asking for attention it has not earned.

rules.name: The Accent Shadow Exception
rules.body: The only permitted colored shadow is the Hearthlight glow on the CTA button — rgba(217,119,6,0.2–0.3). No other element gets a colored ambient shadow.

dos: Do use Hearthlight on ≤10% of any screen. One icon, one CTA, one text emphasis, one status dot — then stop.
Do use tonal surface stepping (Still Surface → Settled → Lifted → Raised) to convey depth before reaching for shadows.
Do use Newsreader italic exclusively for diary prose, pull quotes, and the brand name. Never for UI heading emphasis.
Do keep body copy at 65–75ch maximum line length.
Do apply .grain texture to feature card surfaces representing diary content.
Do give components breathing room. Default card padding is 40px. Never below 24px for content-bearing surfaces.
Do use Label uppercase at 0.05em tracking for all UI chrome: nav links, button text, tags, status indicators.
Do ease with cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) for all entrances. Never ease-in, never bounce, never elastic.
Do tint every neutral toward the warm amber hue. No pure #000000 or #ffffff anywhere.
donts: Don't use bullet-point list UI: no task checkboxes, no icon + label + description rows in a repeated grid.
Don't use note-taking tool aesthetics: no block-by-block structure, no Notion/Craft/Roam editor chrome.
Don't use AI dashboard theatrics: no gradient hero blobs, no 'Powered by AI' badge, no feature-count grids.
Don't use cold productivity SaaS minimalism: white backgrounds, icon-heavy nav bars, grey neutrals without warmth.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Emphasis belongs to weight, scale, or a Hearthlight solid color.
Don't use glassmorphism outside the navigation pill.
Don't add colored ambient shadows to any element except the CTA button.
Don't animate for idle decoration: no looping gradient shifts, no text shimmer, no pulsing background elements.
